reason: The batch report behind the QR code and the batch number matching the box is exactly what I look for, and $24.99 for the first box is an easy trial. I would buy one box and see how I sleep before anything else.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put several forms in one capsule? Also I want to actually see the lab's name and the report before I pay, not just be told it exists.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report on the page turned out to be missing, vague, or did not match the batch number, I would not buy.
